author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed a gene therapy using split AAV vectors to deliver the OTOF gene, restoring hearing in patients with congenital deafness. Clinical trials showed significant improvements in hearing thresholds within six months after a single injection.  

I thought it was important to say here that many Deaf people don't see deafness as something that needs to be "fixed". Deaf culture has a rich history, a proud community, and its own language.

If you're looking for sign language interpretation, I support the company Signapse https://www.signapse.ai/  a brilliant AI-powered ASL and BSL translation tool


Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-025-03773-w
